_about: Genetics rules for the genotypes data type. genotype_pattern finds the model term that holds the lines when neither the manifest entry (genotype_term) nor sim_truth.json (genetics.genotype_term) names it: a treatment term whose analysis.terms meaning, own name, layout column or (for treatment) first spec factor name matches it. A copy of genotype_pattern in Simitall's inst/suite/genetics.json: change both together.
_note_qtn_types: QTN types counted in tpr. gxe_slope rows repeat additive markers and are dropped; epistatic QTN have no marginal effect on average, so a hit on one is not a false positive but they are not in the tpr denominator.
_note_cross_mating: population.mating values that mean the lines come from a cross; n_pcs = auto fits no principal components for them (Simitall's genetics_cross route uses the same list).
